tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything, also the Cut modal surface and the file-picker/field fill. Carries two radial glows (glow-indigo, glow-blue) on html/body.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: .card, the sidebar drawer, the hamburger button, the sort select and Rename/Delete modals.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input fill on admin forms (UserManagement, YoutubeCookieForm) and the Rename modal input. The Enviar Vídeo form uses bg instead.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline for cards, inputs, table rows, outline pills and icon buttons; also the empty trim track and the Switch off state. 1.4:1 on bg: decorative, it does not meet 3:1 for control borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Indigo outline reserved for dialogs: the login card, CutModal, Rename/Delete modals and the submission-history modal. 2.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg, panel and field (18:1 on bg).

tokens.name: text-bright
tokens.usage: Icon strokes on video-card buttons, the hamburger glyph, the Switch knob and the light Save button fill. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and panel (7.8:1): field labels, meta lines, filter-row labels, inactive sidebar links, inactive filter pills, Cancel buttons.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder copy on black media wells only ("Pré-visualização não disponível", 4.6:1 on #000). Never on panel.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: The brand hue: logo wordmark, eyebrow labels, role label, inactive pill-toggle text, the selected trim range, Switch on, the Palavra Completa badge fill and the 2px focus ring. 6.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill of primary actions: .btn-primary and the active pill-toggle. Text on it is accent-fg.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills and on the amber/green status pills.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on light fills that are not accent: content-type badges, active filter pills and the light Save button (same value as bg).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive outline button and .error-text on bg/panel (5.3:1). Only the confirming button inside the delete dialog is red; the trash icon on cards stays neutral.

tokens.name: status-fila
tokens.usage: Submission status Fila (queued), filled pill with white text (4.8:1).

tokens.name: status-baixando
tokens.usage: Submission status Baixando (downloading), filled pill with white text, and the outline Processando clip badge. White on it is 3.7:1: below 4.5:1 at 12px, kept as in the source.

tokens.name: status-processando
tokens.usage: Submission status Processando, filled pill with accent-fg text; also the outline Rascunho clip badge.

tokens.name: status-concluido
tokens.usage: Submission status Concluído, filled pill with accent-fg text; the outline Cortado clip badge; success messages on admin forms.

tokens.name: status-erro
tokens.usage: Submission status Erro, filled pill with white text (3.7:1, below 4.5:1, kept as in the source); error lines in the history modal.

tokens.name: type-pregacao
tokens.usage: Content-type badge fill for Pregação, text ink.

tokens.name: type-louvor
tokens.usage: Content-type badge fill for Louvor and the Música completa format badge, text ink.

tokens.name: type-podcast
tokens.usage: Content-type badge fill for Podcast, text ink.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind every modal dialog.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the sidebar drawer below 720px, and the login card shadow color.

tokens.name: glow-indigo
tokens.usage: Top-left radial glow on the page ground (circle at 20% -10%, fades by 60%).

tokens.name: glow-blue
tokens.usage: Top-right radial glow on the page ground (circle at 100% 0%, fades by 50%).

tokens.name: skeleton-base
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer base stops (25% and 63%).

tokens.name: skeleton-highlight
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer highlight stop (37%).

tokens.name: thumb-from
tokens.usage: Start of the 135deg gradient behind a clip thumbnail.

tokens.name: thumb-to
tokens.usage: End of the 135deg gradient behind a clip thumbnail.

tokens.name: media-well
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind the CutModal video and its no-preview placeholder.

tokens.name: duration-bg
tokens.usage: Duration badge fill over a thumbnail; text is pure white.

tokens.name: play-glyph
tokens.usage: The CSS triangle shown on a thumbnail when a clip has no image.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one h1 per page, under an eyebrow. The login card tightens it to -0.9px.

styles.name: title-modal
styles.usage: Dialog titles: Cortar vídeo, Renomear clipe, Excluir clipe.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Card headings on the admin settings page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cole o link do vídeo completo do YouTube.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Essa ação não pode ser desfeita.
styles.usage: Dialog body, section sub-labels (Histórico de envios), table cells at 0.9rem.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Dialog buttons, the sort select, the Switch label and the dialog subtitle (weight 400 there).

styles.name: clip-name
styles.usage: Clip hook on a video card, clamped to two lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and the card meta line, in text-dim.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Filter pills, filter-row labels (Tipo, Categoria), trim timecodes, clip status dates.

styles.name: pill-label
styles.usage: Filled submission status pills; also the role label in the sidebar (accent-blue).

styles.name: badge-label
styles.usage: Outline clip status badges and content-type badges.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name at the top of the sidebar, in accent-blue. This is the logo; there is no image mark.

styles.name: eyebrow-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section label above every h1 (Biblioteca, Automação, Administração), in accent-blue. The code asks for 400 but only 500/600 are loaded, so it renders at 500.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding on forms, Rename/Delete modal padding, video grid gap, main side padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Space between the submit card and the history list; login card side padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding; login card top/bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Main content top padding, leaving room for the fixed hamburger.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Skeleton text bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary and danger buttons, admin inputs, duration badge, trim track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Sidebar links.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Form inputs, the file picker, sort select, hamburger button, CutModal video.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and every dialog.

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.name: shadow-dialog

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus (:focus-visible) on icon buttons and trim handles: solid accent-blue, 6.8:1 on bg.
